title: The binding of souls
description: A DBD Minecraft Mod! full of strange and scary things
body:
The binding of souls is a DBD minecraft mod, adding killers powers, The Fog and much more!, at this moment in time, the mod has the following in the mod.
- Trapper and Wraith's powers
- Trapper's cabin
- The Junkyard
- Hillbilly's barn
- The Empty fog

Upcomming features include

- Fully functioning Void system
- Perks!
- Survivor items
- Iridecent items
- Deeper layers of the fog
- The blight
- more killer powers

P.S use /give to get the Fog Traveler's Guidebook for some tips and i reccomend right clicking certain items
